name: Barbara Jensen
psychographics: Values maintaining her garden and cooking hobby without weekly friction; enjoys the precision of automation but resists anything that feels like surveillance
current_solutions: Google Home ecosystem; Instacart for groceries; Allrecipes for recipe inspiration
frustration: At 2:14 PM last Tuesday, her smart speaker failed to preheat the oven for her roast chicken, leaving her 45 minutes late for a dinner party; she had to manually override the timer and reset the Wi-Fi router
decision_style: reads verified buyer reviews on Amazon for 20 minutes, then compares features against her existing Google Home devices before committing
voice: blunt and practical, often mid-sentence trailing off when a tech setup feels unnecessarily complex
